schedule.name: S_prime
schedule.best_checkpoint_rule: maximum raw full-VS macro MRR@20 over evaluated epochs; exact tie keeps the earlier epoch

replication.note: no replicas under the deadline; training-seed variance unmeasured

implementation.position_convention: window_start_0_to_len_minus_1_from_validity_mask; PAD contributes nothing; asserted against store position_ids-1
implementation.layout: right_padded_contiguous_prefix; unpadded token-wise LN/QKV/FFN; causal product in padded [B,T] layout
implementation.attention_impl: explicit_fp32_causal_math (lower-triangular incl. diagonal); no SDPA unless equivalence tests pass
implementation.qkv_init: one fused Linear(d,3d); Xavier-uniform applied separately to each [d,d] slice (Wq,Wk,Wv)
implementation.microbatch: 256 unless the post-Gate-C benchmark shows 128x2 faster (systems choice, frozen before training)
implementation.tying: UNTIED: separate output table W_out [K,d] (N(0,0.02) from the common generator) + output bias; class j <-> item token j+3
implementation.input: z = LayerNorm_in(E[item] + P[pos] (+ rich side residual)), then input dropout; no sqrt(d) scale
implementation.recentering: after every optimizer step: W_out -= mean_row(W_out); b -= mean(b)  (loss-neutral)
implementation.monitoring: update_agg every 100 updates logs E/W_out common-mode and median row norms (8192-row sample) and bias mean/std

pair.rule: no early stopping; equal fixed epochs; supervisor/lock assert equal epochs and equal per-epoch permutation digests before any comparison; an arm that cannot finish -> pair reported incomplete, never compared at unequal epochs

d8_ruling: superseded by owner deadline: C0/C1/R0 dropped (Gate P2)

disk_policy.reclaim_allowlist: latest.pt/previous.pt of COMPLETED sasrec_v1 runs only

owner_deadline.owner_choice: TF32 + 6 epochs (A0/A1 only), chosen 2026-09-23T22:40Z via AskUserQuestion after Fable Gate P2

cut_rule.when: once, by the queue runner, after BOTH anchors have completed epoch 2 (systems timing only, no scores)
cut_rule.rule: planned 4 = minimum 4: no cut (2 genuine low-LR epochs kept); a launch after 19:45Z would have required a separately declared 3-epoch plan
cut_rule.applies_to: both anchors identically (equal epochs by construction)

precision.eval: strict_fp32: allow_tf32=False (both), float32_matmul_precision='highest' for every full-VS, cohort and retrospective evaluation
precision.parity_gate: 3 real-data benchmark states x 3000 updates (FP32 seed 2026, FP32 seed 2027, TF32 seed 2026; same batches); pass iff |mean loss TF32_A - FP32_A| over updates 2001-3000 <= |FP32_A - FP32_B| + 0.5% relative, no NaN/Inf, grad-norm medians within 5%
precision.fallback_if_gate_fails: strict FP32 training, planned_epochs 5, eval epochs 3-5 (Fable P2 ALTERNATIVE)

v2_failure.what: v2 A0/A1 (tied, sqrt(d) input scale, betas 0.9/0.98, peak 5e-4) degenerated: train loss min 7.55 at 12k then rising to ~9.0; grad norm 1.8->6.6; full-VS macro MRR@20 A0 0.0913/0.0901, A1 0.1179/0.1168 at epochs 3/4
v2_failure.root_cause: common-mode drift of the tied item table under dense-CE AdamW (row norms ~162 uniform across frequency buckets vs GRU 11-13), amplified 16x into a Pre-LN stream without input LN
v2_failure.decision: stopped at epoch 5 by Fable (owner delegate; owner online and requested the deep review); artifacts archived under runs_v2/

go_no_go_20k.source: Fable deep review VERIFICATION_PLAN (pre-registered before any v3 update)
go_no_go_20k.on_fail: NO-GO: stop both, report v2+v3 honestly (no third attempt fits the deadline)
